title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Japanese Derby. El Condor Pasa is fired up as cheers echo throughout the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She heads to the race, anticipating the looks of respect she'll receive from her rivals after she's won.
